name: Rush Hours
subtitle: The Rush Hours puzzle game, straight from its GitHub releases.
description: Official source of Rush Hours, a free, source-available sliding-block traffic puzzle. Every build comes from the GitHub Actions workflow of the repository and is published in its releases.

apps.name: Rush Hours
apps.subtitle: Slide the cars, free the red one.
apps.localizedDescription:
Slide the cars. Free the red one.

Rush Hours is a sliding-block traffic puzzle. Cars and trucks only move forward and backward in their lane: find the right order to clear a path and drive the red car out of the gridlock. Simple to learn, hard to master.

A CAMPAIGN ON A WORLD MAP
• 700+ levels, from 6-move warm-ups to 63-move brain-burners
• 6×6, 7×7 and 8×8 grids, through themed zones
• Done with the campaign? Generate new levels on your phone, from Easy to Master

A NEW CHALLENGE EVERY DAY
• Daily Challenge: the same puzzle for everyone, one try, no hints, no undo
• Weekly Challenge: a big puzzle that lasts all week
• Replay the last 90 days of daily puzzles as practice

PLAY EVERY DAY
• 3 stars for the minimum number of moves, and the optimal solution replayed after a win
• Daily streak with a calendar, streak freezes, daily missions, XP and 80+ achievements
• 40+ board themes, car skins and win effects, all unlocked by playing: none of them are for sale
• Home screen widget: your streak and the daily challenge

CREATE AND SHARE
Build your own puzzles in the level creator: the game checks that they can be solved and counts their minimum moves. Share them with a QR code or a link.

PLAY WITH FRIENDS (OPTIONAL)
Host a small multiplayer server (Docker) and invite your friends: a private daily challenge with rankings and live 1v1 duels. There is no central server: the app only connects to servers you join yourself.

FAIR AND RESPECTFUL
• No ads, no in-app purchases, no tracking, no account
• Works offline; export your save to move to a new phone
• Light and dark mode, playable with VoiceOver
• English, French and Serbian

Source code: [Rush Hours on GitHub](https://github.com/ekomlenovic/rush%5Fhour%5Fios%5Fandroid)

privacy.NSCameraUsageDescription: Rush Hours uses the camera to scan a level or server invitation QR code.
privacy.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: Rush Hours connects to the multiplayer server you join, which can be on your local network.

New:
• If the app crashes, a screen reassures you instead of a blank one: your progress is kept, and you can retry or export it
• Report a crash in one tap: the report is filled in, you review it before sending
• Fixes and improvements

New:
• Home screen widget: your streak, freezes and the daily challenge
• In duels, spectators can react and cheer the players on
• Scan a QR code to join a server or import a level
• The game music no longer stops your music or podcasts
• Smoother map, garage and win effects on Android
• New language: Serbian
• A daily challenge left open past midnight no longer breaks your streak
• Fixes and improvements
